name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 43/1
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘on the Member States’
part_context: Reiterates its call <del>on the Member States</del>[[47]](#footnote-47) to follow all the recommendations of PEGA and the Venice Commission, which provide important guidance on ensuring compliance with fundamental rights, the rule of law and democratic oversight; stresses the need for full accountability and transparency in all cases of intrusive surveillance; urges the Commission to respond to the growing threats posed by spyware technologies; calls for effective judicial oversight to ensure that surveillance is never used against journalists, activists or political opponents;
